title: Waku Waku 7 (Japan): expansion-RAM compatibility
summary: Supply 1 MB expansion RAM and move the original routine and three edits into guarded disc reads.
rationale: All 45 written bytes map to the exact first-read program. The 40-byte replacement is one bounded contiguous edit authenticated by the complete original sector CRC; the three other writes are in two other sectors. The source image stays unchanged. Inactive replacement-policy candidate. The 2 October comparison runs the exact linked SAROO sector reader on both paths: all 121 checkpoints, full PCM and 27 call/return pairs match. Console timing and complete paired boot remain unqualified.
